# `smelt.tips`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

Discovery tips shown in the prompt bar and banner. `smelt.tips.register(tip)` adds or replaces a prompt tip by `id`; `smelt.settings.show_tips = false` hides all tips. UiHost-only.

## `smelt.tips.enabled`

```lua
fun(): boolean
```

Whether tips are shown (`smelt.settings.show_tips`).

## `smelt.tips.list`

```lua
fun(): smelt.tips.Tip[]
```

Types: [`smelt.tips.Tip`](types.md#smelttipstip)

The registered prompt tips, in registration order.

## `smelt.tips.register`

```lua
fun(tip: smelt.tips.Tip): smelt.tips.Tip
```

Types: [`smelt.tips.Tip`](types.md#smelttipstip)

Register a prompt tip, or replace the tip with the same `id`. Returns the
tip as stored. Raises when `id` or `text` is not a non-empty string.
